name: NPSH margin check
measures: NPSH available compared with NPSH3 / NPSHR plus margin

name: Alignment check (dial indicator TIR or laser)
measures: Shaft offset and angularity at the coupling

name: Vibration analysis against baseline
measures: Vibration signature compared with a healthy baseline

name: Infrared thermography
measures: Hot spots on bearings and motor

name: Seal leakage measurement
measures: Leakage rate compared with manufacturer specification

name: Suction-line leak test
measures: Air leaks at suction flanges and piping

name: Liquid level / submergence check
measures: Supply level and vortex formation at suction inlet

name: Performance test against pump curve
measures: Flow and head compared with the pump curve

name: Internal inspection
measures: Impeller, wear rings, passages and suction strainer
